title: The trader's screen
hook: Two stated cases: explore sensitivity to the assumed loss weight.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How sensitivity to the assumed loss weight affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Value, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare sensitivity to the assumed loss weight in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
